recommendations.issue: Slow wait times caused by kitchen bottlenecks and understaffing during peak dining periods
recommendations.action: Restructure kitchen station workflows and add an additional prep cook during peak hours to streamline ticket times.
recommendations.expected_impact: Significant reduction in wait times, higher table turnover, and improved customer satisfaction scores.

recommendations.issue: Inconsistent food quality and taste due to lack of quality control during high-volume hours
recommendations.action: Implement strict plating checklists and require the head chef to perform quality checks on 100% of outgoing dishes during peak rushes.
recommendations.expected_impact: More consistent food presentation and flavor, reducing negative reviews regarding culinary quality.

recommendations.issue: High pricing perception misaligned with customer value expectations and portion sizes
recommendations.action: Review menu mix to introduce affordable entry-level items and audit portion sizes to ensure perceived value matches pricing.
recommendations.expected_impact: Lower resistance to menu prices and improved value-for-money ratings among budget-conscious diners.

recommendations.issue: Staff attitude issues driven by high stress and lack of structured customer service training
recommendations.action: Conduct bi-weekly customer service workshops focusing on de-escalation, positivity, and stress management during rushes.
recommendations.expected_impact: Friendlier staff interactions, better morale, and improved customer service ratings.

recommendations.issue: Ambience and environment complaints related to overcrowding, noise, and poor seating layout
recommendations.action: Optimize the dining room floor plan to improve traffic flow and add sound-absorbing panels to mitigate excessive noise levels.
recommendations.expected_impact: A more comfortable, pleasant dining atmosphere that enhances overall guest comfort.
